method: Original and refactored emitter source compiled with Clang 23 using identical synthetic metric records; 313 member names seeded, normal/tiny/large floating values, booleans, integer counts, arrays/vectors and escaped commit metadata. No benchmark algorithms run. JSON parsed without removing any fields.

escaping_regression.correction: The shared escaper now uses nlohmann JSON string encoding; legacy stream emitters no longer emit malformed JSON for otherwise unescaped control characters.

invalid_utf8_disposition: The original mandatory KNN nlohmann serializer already rejected invalid UTF-8 before any output files were written. The shared escaper preserves that whole-run failure behavior; no replacement/ignore policy was introduced.
